create_modelslim_w4a4_quant_scheme: create a ModelSlimW4A4Int4 quantization scheme instance from a quant config dict and prefix string
build_weight_tensor: build an int8 weight tensor dict with output_size by input_size shape for W4A4 quantization
build_perchannel_params: build per-channel weight scale and offset tensors for a given output size and dtype
create_weights_on_layer: create and register int8 weight and per-channel scale/offset parameters on a PyTorch layer module
apply_quantized_weights: apply quantized W4A4 weights to an input tensor with optional bias via NPU kernel
